scope: Current daily/weekly Host records and latest-only wall-clock recurrence

paired.method: Actual fixed Schedule domain.ts/Temporal versus Native; exact creation, decoding, dispatch and public error values.

verification.source: 165 original daily.spec.ts and weekly.spec.ts tests passed; their broader service coverage is not claimed as Native integration.
verification.native: 15 passed: current wall/interval/instant contracts and historical Schedule regressions.

behavior: Strict local times normalize to millisecond precision; explicit ISO weekday sets reject duplicates and retain unique ascending immutable values.

Creation skips nonexistent local dates/times and uses the earlier overlap. Dispatch selects one latest due occurrence and excludes its local date from the future search, while preserving a committed occurrence if current zone data shifts the rule earlier.

Gregorian day walks and boundary projections handle local year zero/10000 around the four-digit UTC range, so year-end exhaustion remains finite in positive and negative offset zones. Stored records retain their committed target and checked aliases without recalculating a schedule on read.

cleanup.retained: Commands, input hashes, paired values, Native logs/XML/observations and Source results; owned synthetic short workspaces and homes removed.

limitations: Cron/RRULE, Host storage, management, runtime and current tool integration remain pending. These staged primitives do not change production Schedule bindings.
No complete regression, application/session, Portable/browser/Win7 acceptance or upstream promotion.
